source: Measured from TinyGo 0.43 `-opt z -gc=none` builds in QEMU (`mps2-an386`, Cortex-M4), with BS-sourced bursts on every slot and the spurious domain check open for the measurement. CPU counts the cycles of the `rf` and `fsktx` code and of the bench loop per second of signal. RAM is the `Transmitter` or `AudioTransmitter` and the most stack under it.
